content.title: Replace single status ladder with crop-specific paths
content.statement: The board replaced the single status ladder with one status path per crop type.
content.context: The existing status ladder did not fit growers' workflow, causing unnecessary steps and incorrect batch statuses.
content.rationale: To match each crop type’s actual process: seed-grown crops keep the full ladder, rooted cuttings start at growing, and bought-in finished plants start at ready, while discarded remains available at any step.
content.impacts: Requires Aisha to redesign the status picker and Marc to add a crop type field and migrate existing batches; improves accuracy and reduces unnecessary steps for growers.

sources.excerpt: Decision: the board replaced the single status ladder with one status path per crop type.
Growers had to tap through statuses that never happened, and Paul found 41 batches with the wrong status after the first two weeks.
Seed-grown crops keep the full ladder, rooted cuttings start at growing, and bought-in finished plants start at ready.
Discarded stays available at any step.
